description: This file defines the interface for a chat grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, along with custom serialization logic for the XDocument type.

classes.name: XDocumentSerialization
classes.description: A custom serializer and copier for the XDocument type, providing surrogate serialization and deep copy functionality.

classes.name: XDocumentSurrogate
classes.description: A serializer struct acting as a surrogate for XDocument, storing its XML content as a string.

methods.name: GetChat
methods.description: Retrieves the current content of the chat room as an XDocument.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds a new post to the chat with the specified GUID, user, and text.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the post identified by the given GUID.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits the post identified by the GUID, updating its text.
